sample.title: Megaspeed, the company at the center of the Jensen Huang scandal, appears headed for a US blacklist
sample.text: Megaspeed, which was previously led by Alice Huang, would be barred from doing business with U.S. companies unless those companies attained a special license from the federal government.

sample.title: Even the best AI agents struggle with everyday life
sample.text: As millions embrace personal AI assistants, a new benchmark reveals that even the most advanced AI models struggle to complete everyday tasks reliably and safely without introducing potential new problems.

sample.title: UK warns AI-driven cyberattacks are exposing years of weak security
sample.text: The British cyber agency says that "building strong foundations has never mattered more" as AI hacking tools rely on exploiting simple security flaws.
sample.summary: الجهاز البريطاني للサイبر يحذر من أن الهجمات السيبرانية المدعومة بالذكاء الاصطناعي تكشف عن Years of Weak Security. يؤكد أن بناء الأسس القوية أصبح أكثر أهمية نظراً لاعتماد أدوات الاختراق الذكية على استغلال الثغرات الأمنية البسيطة.

sample.title: CVE-2026-90436: Apache Axis Unsafe Reflection Vulnerability
sample.text: Apache Axis contains an unsafe reflection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted SOAP fault message that causes Axis to load and instantiate an attacker-specified class when a suitable class is available on the application classpath. The impacted product(s) could be end-of-life (EoL) and/or end-of-service (EoS). Users are advised to discontinue use and/or transition to a supported version.
sample.summary: Apache Axis يحتوي على عيب فيfection 反馈，请使用阿拉伯语回答。该组件存在一个不安全的反射漏洞，未认证的远程攻击者可以通过构造特殊的SOAP故障消息来执行任意代码。受影响的产品可能已经处于生命周期末期，用户应停止使用并迁移到受支持的版本。

sample.text: Synology DSM contains an improper encoding or escaping of output vulnerability in the system plugin daemon in Synology BeeStation OS (BSM) that could allow a remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via unspecified vectors.
sample.summary: النظام Synology DiskStation Manager (DSM) يحتوي على عيب في ترميز أو تهيئة الخرج في دايمون نظام البرامج الإضافية في Synology BeeStation OS (BSM)، مما يتيح لخاطف مotebeli نائي تنفيذ كود عشوائي عبر مسارات غير محددة.

sample.title: CVE-2026-132719: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulne
sample.text: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki. This vulnerability is associated with program files includes/parser/Sanitizer.php. This issue affects MediaWiki: from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, 1.47.
sample.summary: هذا النص يتحدث عن ثغرة أمنية متعلقة بـ "Cross-site Scripting" في برنامج MediaWiki من مؤسسة ويكيميديا. هذه الثغرة موجودة في ملفات البرنامج includes/parser/Sanitizer.php، وتأثرت نسخاً معينة من MediaWiki من الإصدار 1.43.0 إلى 1.43.12، و 1.45.0 إلى 1.45.7، و 1.46.0 إلى 1.46.3، و 1.47.

sample.text: Cross-Site Request Forgery (CSRF) vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki - SecurePoll Extension. This vulnerability is associated with program files includes/Pages/TranslatePage.php. This issue affects MediaWiki - SecurePoll Extension: 1.43, 1.45, 1.46, 1.47.

sample.title: CVE-2026-135816: A flaw has been found in GouguCMS up to 4.08.18. This affects the function detail of the f
sample.text: A flaw has been found in GouguCMS up to 4.08.18. This affects the function detail of the file app/home/controller/Pages.php. Executing a manipulation can lead to code injection. It is possible to launch the attack remotely. The exploit has been published and may be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.
sample.summary: تم اكتشاف ثغرة في نسخة GouguCMS حتى 4.08.18، وتؤثر هذه الثغرة على وظيفة تفاصيل الملف في ملف Pages.php. يمكن تنفيذ التلاعب في هذه الثغرة لاستغلالها في عملية حقن الكود. يمكن تنفيذ الهجوم عن بُعد، وقد تم نشر الاستغلال وقد يكون في استخدامه.

sample.title: CVE-2026-124284: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Securi
sample.text: A critical security vulnerability affects certain authentication methods in Genetec Security Center, including external identity providers using OpenID Connect (OIDC) or SAML 2.0, and Active Directory Federation Services (AD FS) using WS-Trust or WS-Federation. Under specific conditions, successful exploitation may allow an unauthenticated attacker to gain unauthorized access to the system with the privileges of an affected user. Successful exploitation requires a specific combination of conditions to be met, which reduces the likelihood of a successful attack.
sample.summary: هناك عيب أمني حرج في بعض طرق التحقق في مركز Genetec Security Center، مما قد يتيح لخاطف غير مصرح به الوصول غير المصرح به إلى النظام باستخدام معرفات المستخدم المتضررة. هذا العيب يتأثر بروابط الهوية الخارجية التي تستخدم OpenID Connect أو SAML 2.0، وخدمات ت Federate التحقق من Active Directory باستخدام WS-Trust أو WS-Federation.

sample.title: CVE-2026-132673: Improper Access Control vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki. This vulnerabilit
sample.text: Improper Access Control vulnerability in Wikimedia Foundation MediaWiki. This vulnerability is associated with program files includes/Specials/SpecialChangeCredentials.php, includes/Specials/SpecialLinkAccounts.php, includes/Specials/SpecialUnlinkAccounts.php. This issue affects MediaWiki: from 1.43.0 before 1.43.12, from 1.45.0 before 1.45.7, from 1.46.0 before 1.46.3, 1.47.
sample.summary: هناك عيب في السيطرة على الوصول غير المناسب في برنامج MediaWiki من Wikimedia Foundation، ويتعلق هذا العيب بملفات البرنامج includes/Specials/SpecialChangeCredentials.php، includes/Specials/SpecialLinkAccounts.php، وincludes/Specials/SpecialUnlinkAccounts.php. 影响的MediaWiki版本包括从1.43.0到1.43.11，从1.45.0到1.45.6，以及从1.46.0到1.46.2。
